display_long_description:
# Disembodied is... It's kind of like... It's sort of... Well it's a bit different.
You won't need your controllers here.
# Hands Only
Control a pair of disembodied hands, that will magically copy what your real hands do.
[media]

# Gameplay
Play **seated** or **standing**. Manoeuvre the hands through **175 levels**, featuring a wide range of mechanics. From pure climbing courses, to precision laser challenges, to chilled puzzle levels, to fast pace chaos.

[media]

# Physics
Find your own style with precise, physics-driven movement.
[media]

# Power-Ups
Collect Power-Ups, then make hand gestures to activate them.
[media]

# Level Editor
Create your own levels and test them instantly using the advanced level editor.
[media]

# Mixed Reality
Get fully immersed with advanced light settings and full occlusion (see real things in front of virtual things).
*The Quest 2/Pro version doesn't have some Mixed Reality features, and the real world will be in black and white on Quest 2.
[media]

# Early Access
The game will launch with a full single player campaign of 175 levels, and an experimental Level Editor. During the Early Access period I aim to refine the experience, and add more content, based on player feedback, so join the Discord to get involved.
